A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–F. All 26 pages support reliable comparison; appendix pages 14–26 are identical in text and rendered appearance.

before.justification: v1 reports original pilot results, four-model stress tests in Table 3 and Figure 4, training comparisons in Table 4, and supplementary empirical analyses in Appendix E.

after.justification: v2 retains the original pilot, stress-test and training results, together with the appendix case studies and sensitivity analyses.

M1.justification: The NCB score and SAT procedure are unchanged. Sections 2 and 5 and Algorithm 1 retain the same neighborhood aggregation, frozen teacher, contextualized student inputs, and KL-divergence objective.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same four-domain Neighbor-Enriched Dataset sourced from SimpleQA, HotpotQA and SciQ, C4 training contexts, peer/source interference scenarios, and MMLU/GSM8k evaluations. The added Santos et al. citation introduces no evaluated dataset.

E2.justification: Table 4 retains Vanilla, Answer-Based Augmentation and Knowledge-Based Augmentation as comparators. Table 3 retains the same inference-strategy comparisons. None of the newly cited works becomes an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Sections 3–5 and Appendix D retain the same model configurations, NCB percentile subsets, interference settings, accuracy/coverage metrics, and training datasets and budgets. No evaluation protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: Figure 4 retains the interference-intensity, configuration and model-scaling analyses. Appendix E retains the same case studies, popularity/difficulty analysis, positional-bias test, and neighbor-quantity and weighting sensitivity tests.

E5.justification: The documented sampling remains 30 responses per target question and 10 per neighbor question, with 30 independent decoding runs in the pilot. Statistical displays and uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Result entries and findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. Tables 3 and 4 and the main figures match visually; for example, Table 4 retains SAT's 93.0% accuracy on newly learned facts and 60.6% average stress-test accuracy.

T1.justification: Section 2 and Appendix B retain the same latent-state definitions, Bayesian odds derivation, equal-baseline and conditional-independence assumptions, and geometric-mean NCB surrogate. No mathematical reasoning or formal definition is revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the claims that self-consistency can mask brittle knowledge, NCB indicates structural belief robustness, and SAT reduces learned-knowledge brittleness by approximately 30%. Their scientific scope is unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations of NCB robustness, reasoning/reflection effects and scaling are retained. The limitations concerning neighbor relations, static knowledge, human validation and computational overhead, along with Appendix B's qualifications, are unchanged.

D1.justification: The first-page footnote changes from 'Code will be available' to 'Code is available' at the same repository, updating the reported release status. Implementation details, hyperparameters and prompts are unchanged. Actual repository accessibility is not established by the PDFs.

R1.justification: v2 adds Hua et al. (2024) and Azaria et al. (2024) to the introduction's truthfulness discussion, and Santos et al. (2024) to Section 3.1's benchmark contrast, with corresponding bibliography entries. The broader positioning and Section 6 discussion remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Edits are limited to citation insertions, the code-availability footnote and the version/date header. The prose and section sequence otherwise remain unchanged, without substantial rewriting or reorganization.

P2.justification: Minor reflow shifts Table 2 and Algorithm 1 vertically within pages 4 and 8 and changes column breaks and bibliography placement. Existing figures, table structures and captions are retained without redesign.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves documentation through three additional supporting references and a code notice that reports availability instead of a future release. These provide clearer attribution and reproducibility information, although repository accessibility cannot be verified from the PDFs. The scientific evidence, theory and limitations remain unchanged, so the improvement is limited.
